pages.text: The Akaishi Crystal is the base currency and fuel of the tech line; it is required by recipes, power generation and refining.$(br2)$(bold)First recipe:$(reset) fill a 3×3 grid with 9 crystals to obtain 1 $(bold)Raw Akaishi Block$(reset) (reversible back into 9 crystals).$(br2)Raw Akaishi Blocks are the Purifier's raw material and fuel and the generator's second-tier fuel. $(bold)One Raw Akaishi Block outburns ten crystals.$(reset)

Akaishi Essence is the refined intermediate: a Raw Akaishi Block or Crystal Block fed into the $(l:akaishi:purifier)Purifier$(/l) produces essence. It can be concentrated into two premium materials:$(li)9 essence → Compressed Akaishi Essence, used in upgrade templates and fusion parts$(li)9 essence → Compressed Akaishi Essence Block, reversible, used for the Equipment Forger and reactor/fusion shells$(br2)$(bold)Fuel follows the same ladder:$(reset) essence, Compressed Akaishi Essence and Compressed Akaishi Essence Block are tiers 3-5 of the generator fuel list.

Three further members of the crystal family:$(li)$(bold)Akaishi Crystal Block$(reset): 9 crystals pressed in the Compressor (reversible); feeding it to a Purifier or Matrix yields 4 essence$(li)Akaishi Crystal Geode: produces clusters over time and can be upgraded by the Aggregator$(li)Akaishi Crystal Cluster: mined for 1-2 essence$(br2)Geode-based growth and harvesting forms the mid-game crystal farm; see the Catalyst entry in the Advanced Industry chapter.

Reading order: mine crystals from ore → extract essence from blocks at the Purifier → concentrate essence into premium materials → condense an Akaishi Ingot at the Aggregator. The Compressor's dust-to-block and crystal-to-crystal-block recipes also feed this chain.
